name: Mitsui Matsushima Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Mitsui Matsushima Holdings Co., Ltd. through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of mask blanks, measuring instruments and production equipment for quartz devices, and related products in Japan, Australia, and internationally. The company manufactures and sells drinking straws and food containers; office equipment centering on shredders; pet foods and related products; hardware and plastic products for housing and furniture; shredders; and roll products, such as recording paper for register rolls.
